summary: This directory defines the core data schemas, type definitions, and structural representations used to model and document software packages. It serves as the foundational data layer for analyzing source code and generating standardized project documentation.
responsibilities: Define schema for package and file analysis
Model structural metadata and dependency graphs
Specify requirements and structures for documentation generation
Standardize input data for system analysis and reporting
relationships: Package analysis structures aggregate internal source code metadata to provide a comprehensive view of the codebase.
Documentation structures rely on package analysis outputs to populate content based on defined section identifiers.
Type definitions enforce consistency across both the analysis of project structures and the generation of documentation outputs.
designDecisions: Use of strongly-typed TypeScript interfaces to define data structures
Compositional approach to modeling complex project components
Separation of structural metadata from generation logic
Centralization of localized configuration for documentation
